patch_description:
The current program has 16 distinct parameters and a combined score of 0.57, while a prior simpler program achieved 0.59 with only 10 distinct parameters. The recommendation to add an initial global RZ layer aligns with improving phase flexibility without parameter explosion.

Key improvements:
1. Prepend 8 RZ gates with a shared parameter "rz_init" on all qubits - this provides global phase control at the start with only 1 new distinct parameter
2. Consolidate to a single, well-tuned entangling block instead of two similar blocks - reduces depth and parameters while maintaining expressivity
3. Use aggressive parameter sharing: keep ry_0 and ry_1 alternating pattern, and reuse the same entangling parameter names across structured positions
4. This follows the successful structure from prior program 2 but enhances it with initial phase flexibility

The initial RZ layer gives the optimizer extra degrees of freedom to tune global phases at low cost, improving convergence and robustness on hard samples (worst_group_margin). Fewer distinct parameters directly improves the score through parameter_efficiency metric.
